title: Integrated Verbal Ability Sets
tagline: Year 4 — A full verbal mix: synonyms, antonyms, fill-blanks, idioms, sentence correction, error spotting, jumbles and short comprehension

introduction.overview: A verbal section mixes small vocabulary and grammar items with jumbles and short passages. Integrated sets train the switch between them. Each type has its own quick method: vocabulary by context, grammar by rule, jumbles by links, comprehension by structure. The most valuable habit is to do the quickest types first and to leave long passages for last.
introduction.placementRelevance: Mixed verbal sets are how most company tests present the English section.
introduction.realWorldContext: Switching between proofreading, reading and word choice is typical of office writing.

learningObjectives: Apply the standard method to each type
Check answers against grammar and context

prerequisiteKnowledge.quickRefresher: Vocabulary: context. Grammar: rule. Jumbles: opener and links. Comprehension: structure.

coreDefinitions: Fill-blank: a sentence with a gap to complete.
Sentence correction: choose the grammatical version.
Error spotting: find the wrong part.
Jumble: restore the order of sentences.
Mini-passage: a short paragraph with one question.
conceptExplanation.theoreticalIntuition: Every verbal item is a small puzzle with one rule. Know the rule and the puzzle takes seconds.
conceptExplanation.visualOrMentalModel: Classify by looking at the format; apply the matching quick method; move on.

importantRulesAndFormulas.title: Agreement
importantRulesAndFormulas.formula: Neither… nor → verb agrees with the nearer subject
importantRulesAndFormulas.simpleExample: Neither the teacher nor the students were

importantRulesAndFormulas.title: Than
importantRulesAndFormulas.formula: Compared with a pronoun that could take a verb: than I am

importantRulesAndFormulas.title: Idiom
importantRulesAndFormulas.formula: Turn over a new leaf = start afresh

mainNarrative: "Neither of the boys has finished his work": "neither" is singular, so has and his.
"Neither the teacher nor the students were aware": the verb agrees with the nearer subject (students), so were.
For a jumble such as "It was a stormy night / Suddenly there was a knock / He opened the door / A cold wind rushed in", the order is stormy night, knock, door, wind.
A short passage question is answered from the passage: bees' dance carries enough information to guide others, as shown by the robotic bee.
"He was exhausted; nevertheless, he continued working" uses a contrast connector.

deepDiveAspects.title: Pronoun after than
deepDiveAspects.content: "Taller than I" is understood as "taller than I am".

deepDiveAspects.title: Single clue elimination
deepDiveAspects.content: One clear rule often removes three options at once.

solvedExamples.title: Agreement
solvedExamples.question: Neither the teacher nor the students ____ aware of the change.

solvedExamples.title: Jumble
solvedExamples.question: Order: R It was a stormy night; S Suddenly there was a knock; P He opened the door; Q A cold wind rushed in.

solvedExamples.title: Connector
solvedExamples.question: He was exhausted; ____, he continued working.

traditionalVsShortcut.shortcutMethod: Identify the type from the format, apply its quick rule, and defer long passages to the end.

placementTips.eliminationTechnique: Apply one rule to eliminate options quickly.
placementTips.questionSelectionAdvice: Do vocabulary and grammar items first.
placementTips.recruiterInsight: Time saved on quick items pays for passages.

easy.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to "candid".
easy.explanation: "Candid" means open and honest, which is frank.

easy.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to "scarce".
easy.explanation: Scarce means in short supply; plentiful is the opposite.

easy.question: She was so ____ in her book that she forgot lunch.
easy.explanation: "Engrossed" means completely absorbed, which explains forgetting lunch.

intermediate.question: Passage: Bees communicate the location of flowers by dancing. The angle of the dance shows direction and its length shows distance. Researchers whose robotic bee performed the dance successfully sent real bees to chosen locations. The experiment shows that
options: the dance carries enough information to guide other bees
intermediate.correctAnswer: the dance carries enough information to guide other bees
intermediate.explanation: Real bees followed the robot's dance, so the dance carries the guiding information.

intermediate.question: Find the part with the error: Each of the players / were given / a medal / by the captain.
Choose the word closest in meaning to "frugal".

advanced.question: Order the sentences: P She studied hard for months. Q Her result was outstanding. R Priya wanted a place in the medical college. S Last week the list was published.
advanced.explanation: Her aim (R), her work (P), the list (S), her result (Q).

advanced.question: Passage: Paper is made from wood pulp, but recycled paper needs less energy and water. However, recycling cannot continue for ever, because the fibres shorten each time and eventually become too short to bind. Which conclusion is supported?
options: Recycling reduces but cannot remove the need for fresh fibre
Recycled paper is stronger than new paper
advanced.correctAnswer: Recycling reduces but cannot remove the need for fresh fibre
advanced.explanation: Fibres shorten with each cycle, so fresh fibre is still needed.

placementStyle.question: Choose the correct indirect question.
options: He did not know where was the station.
He did not know where the station was.
He did not knew where the station was.
He did not know where the station is was.
placementStyle.correctAnswer: He did not know where the station was.
placementStyle.explanation: In an indirect question the verb follows the subject: "where the station was".

placementStyle.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to "adjourned" in "The meeting was adjourned".
placementStyle.explanation: To adjourn is to break off until a later time.

placementStyle.question: Neither the teacher nor the students ____ aware of the change.
placementStyle.explanation: The verb agrees with the nearer subject, "students", so "were".
